title: Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
description:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

  • Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.

  • Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.

  • Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.

  • Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.

  • Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.

  • Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.

  • Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

  • Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.

  • +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.

  • Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.

  • Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.

  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Mission

To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.

The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.

Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Health insurance

  • 28 days annual leave

title: Software Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Accountant (mid level) is a key member of a small, hands-on Financial Control team, responsible for contributing directly to the month-end close process and supporting the delivery of accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information. The role will own individual tasks and areas of responsibility.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, Financial Control Accountant (mid Level) will be actively involved in preparing and supporting core financial control activities, completing month-end tasks, investigating balances and variances, and working through accounting entries and reconciliations to ensure the general ledger is accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the role will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately

title: Financial Reporting Manager
description:
Financial Reporting Manager

About ClearBank

ClearBank is a technology enabled clearing bank, built on a modern cloud-based platform. We provide real-time clearing and embedded banking services, enabling our clients to build better financial services. Our culture is grounded in trust, ownership, and collaboration, empowering our people to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and each other.

Role Purpose

The Financial Reporting Manager is responsible for leading the Group’s external financial reporting, including end-to-end ownership of the Annual Report and Accounts (ARA), consolidated financial statements and statutory accounts. The role ensures accurate, timely and compliant reporting in line with IFRS, regulatory requirements and corporate disclosure standards, while coordinating stakeholders across Finance, the wider business and external audit.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting & Statutory Accounts

  • Own and lead the end-to-end preparation of the Group’s Annual Report and Accounts, including the consolidated IFRS financial statements, notes and disclosures, and project manage compilation of the front-half strategic and governance reports

  • Prepare and oversee standalone statutory accounts for regulated banking entities in the UK and EU, including the primary statements, supporting notes and front-half narrative sections

  • Translate IFRS, company law, regulatory and corporate reporting requirements into complete, accurate and appropriately evidenced financial statement disclosures

  • Develop and maintain robust working papers, disclosure checklists, review processes and scalable financial controls that support the accuracy, completeness and auditability of published reporting

  • Own the detailed reporting plan and critical path, coordinate inputs and reviews across multiple stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver against Board, audit, filing and other external deadlines

Audit & Assurance

  • Lead the external audit workstream as part of the wider statutory reporting cycle, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

  • Coordinate audit evidence and responses across the business, ensuring requests are resolved efficiently without compromising ownership or delivery of the financial statements

  • Monitor audit progress, judgement and outstanding matters, escalating and resolving issues to protect the reporting timetable and governance process

  • Drive the timely resolution of audit findings and ensure agreed actions are embedded into future reporting processes and controls

  • Prepare robust going concern assessment papers using the 5-year planning projections, latest ICAAP and other applicable internal reports and liaising with relevant internal stakeholders.

Maintain strong, current knowledge of IFRS and apply it in drafting, reviewing and supporting the Group’s financial statements, accounting policies, notes and disclosures

  • Assess the impact of new and revised IFRS standards, amendments and IFRIC interpretations, as well as emerging corporate reporting requirements and FRC updates, through structured horizon scanning and impact assessments

  • Partner with Financial Control and other subject-matter experts to implement new or amended accounting requirements, including IFRS 18, and reflect business developments appropriately in external reporting

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across Finance and the wider business

  • Early engagement of stakeholders to ensure alignment on reporting requirements and timeliness of delivery

  • Influence and coordinate multiple contributors to deliver high-quality, FTSE-grade outputs

  • Be the owner, act as a trusted advisor and the go-to on external reporting matters

Governance & Board Reporting

  • Prepare impactful Board-level papers including going concern assessments, horizon scanning, and annual report and audit updates

  • Support the Board Audit Committees’ reporting throughout the reporting cycle including the co-ordination of annual report reviews

  • Ensure clear, concise, and high-quality communication of financial information to senior stakeholders

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Essential

  • At least two years’ recent, hands-on experience preparing and project managing and owning the Annual Reports and Accounts and statutory financial statements, ideally within fintech, banking, payments or broader financial services

  • Strong practical knowledge of IFRS, with the ability to apply accounting and disclosure requirements when drafting and reviewing financial statements, notes and accounting policies

  • Demonstrable experience preparing consolidated financial statements and statutory accounts from planning and working papers through review, approval and filing, rather than experience limited to external audit

  • Proven ability to own a complex reporting timetable, coordinate multiple contributors, manage dependencies and deliver a complete set of high-quality financial statements to deadline

  • Experience managing the external audit process from the preparer side and working constructively with auditors while retaining ownership of the accounts and reporting process

  • Strong stakeholder management, technical writing and attention to detail, with the ability to explain accounting judgements and influence across Finance and the wider business

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification financial reporting experience

Desirable / Nice to have:

  • Experience preparing Annual Reports and Accounts for regulated banking or financial services entities in the UK and/or EU

  • Experience applying complex IFRS requirements, developing accounting policies and preparing technical accounting papers and disclosure assessments

  • Familiarity with Board and Audit Committee reporting, governance reviews and the statutory approval and filing process

title: Manager, Strategic Sales
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Sales Manager to help build and lead our founding team of Enterprise Account Executives in London. Enterprise at Baseten means the companies with the most to gain from AI and the most complexity in getting there: large digital natives running products at massive scale, and category leaders in software, financial services, healthcare, and beyond. They have the data, the distribution, and the budget. Most are still deciding what to build, what to run themselves, and what it should cost.

You'll help recruit the first reps, run deals alongside them while the team ramps, and contribute to the playbook for how Baseten wins European enterprises. It's a founding seat with real influence on how we build here, close to our founders and GTM leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, hire, and ramp the founding team of Enterprise AEs in London. This is your highest-leverage work in year one

  • Coach reps through long, multi-stakeholder cycles: multithreading across buying committees, navigating security and procurement, and closing seven- and eight-figure deals

About the role
(Hybrid)

As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences.

This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning.

What you’ll be doing

  • Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions.

  • Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated.

  • Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability.

  • Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against.

  • Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.

  • Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community.

About you

  • Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners.

  • Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure.

  • An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed.

  • Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table.

  • End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest.

  • Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab.

  • Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter.

Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

What you’ll work on

You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.

  • Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.

  • Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.

  • Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.

  • Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.

  • Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.

Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.

What you’ll get

Send your CV.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you’re ready to take on next.

title: Founding Customer Success Manager
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We are hiring a Founding Customer Success Lead/Manager for the UK market.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a market and a function, not simply manage a book of business or an expansion. You will work with some of our most strategic customers, helping them move from initial experimentation to broad, measurable adoption of AI across their organizations.

You will own the full customer journey, from executive alignment and implementation through long-term adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. You will build trusted relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, help customers navigate the organizational change that comes with adopting AI, and turn successful customer outcomes into a repeatable Customer Success motion from our London HQ.

As our first senior Customer Success leader based at the London HQ, you will help define how Dust serves customers from the office. You will create playbooks, establish operating rhythms, shape our approach to executive engagement, and feed what you learn back into the wider Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Deployment teams.

Dust is an AI-native company, and that changes what Customer Success can look like. You will help customers understand how AI can reshape their work while using AI to make your own practice more effective, scalable, and precise.

This role is suited to someone who combines executive presence with a strong builder's mindset. You should be comfortable operating without a finished playbook, making decisions with incomplete information, and taking responsibility for outcomes from beginning to end.

What you will do

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, building durable relationships across executive, business, technical, and operational stakeholders.

  • Establish trusted-advisor relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, helping them define their AI strategy and turn that strategy into meaningful business outcomes.

  • Lead complex customer journeys from kickoff through adoption, renewal, and expansion. You will coordinate the right people at the right time and make sure progress does not stall between teams.

  • Drive measurable value realization by helping customers identify, quantify, and communicate outcomes such as time saved, costs reduced, faster execution, and improved decision-making.

  • Lead executive business reviews and other strategic customer conversations, connecting product usage to business impact and creating a clear path to the next stage of adoption.

  • Support customers through enterprise-wide change management, including rollout planning, governance, internal enablement, use-case discovery, and the transition from individual experimentation to organization-wide adoption.

  • Identify and develop expansion opportunities across teams, functions, and geographies. You will partner closely with Sales to turn strong adoption and customer outcomes into sustainable account growth.

  • Orchestrate internal resources across Customer Success, AI Deployment Strategy, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales to deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Build the foundations of Dust's Customer Success motion from the London HQ, including account planning, executive engagement, adoption frameworks, value reviews, customer education, and feedback loops.

  • Represent the voice of customers inside Dust by turning customer needs, use cases, and patterns into clear product feedback, strategic insight, and better ways of working.

  • Contribute to the broader Customer Success team by sharing what works, raising the bar for strategic account management, and helping shape how a GenAI-native CS organization operates.

What we are looking for

  • You have 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, solutions, or a related customer-facing role, with a strong track record of owning and growing strategic enterprise accounts.

  • You have worked with complex organizations where adoption requires sustained executive alignment, cross-functional coordination, and thoughtful change management over multiple quarters.

  • You have successfully managed senior customer relationships, including the ability to influence C-level and VP-level stakeholders and communicate credibly with business and technical audiences.

  • You have a track record of driving measurable customer outcomes, renewals, and expansion. You can move comfortably between strategic conversations and the operational details needed to make progress.

  • You have built or improved Customer Success processes, playbooks, or operating models. You know how to create structure where little exists and how to turn individual success into a repeatable motion.

  • You understand how technically sophisticated products are adopted inside large organizations. Experience with AI, developer tools, data platforms, enterprise software, or another emerging technology category is highly valuable.

  • You are fluent in AI concepts and are genuinely curious about how agents, language models, and automation will change the way companies operate. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to engage confidently with technical teams and build practical AI fluency with customers.

  • You communicate with clarity and conviction in English, both in writing and in executive settings. French is helpful because you will work closely with our Paris-based teams, but it is not essential.

  • You have strong judgment, initiative, and ownership. You make sound decisions under ambiguity, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You are comfortable being both strategic and hands-on. You can lead an executive business review in the morning, rethink an onboarding process in the afternoon, and write the first version of a playbook when the team needs one.

  • You are generous with context, direct in your communication, and committed to working as part of a team. You make the people around you better.

What success looks like

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Built strong relationships with the key executives, champions, and decision-makers across your customer portfolio.

  • Created clear account plans and adoption strategies for each strategic customer.

  • Established a repeatable approach to executive engagement, value realization, and expansion planning from the London HQ.

  • Helped customers move from isolated AI experiments to repeatable, high-value workflows used across teams.

  • Identified the most important customer and market patterns and turned them into actionable feedback for Dust's Product and Go-to-Market teams.

  • Created the first building blocks of a scalable Customer Success playbook.

Over time, you will help make Dust indispensable to some of the most ambitious companies and define what exceptional Customer Success looks like for an AI operating system.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Agents at work - Latent Space, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

  • LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time - dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. 
 
Research

  • Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods
  • Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients
  • Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality  
  • Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients
  • Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects
  • Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners
Comms and External Engagement
  • Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences
  • Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media
  • Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations 
Supervision
  • Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development
  • Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. 
 
For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59.
 
Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered.
 
Please apply following the link below.
 
Indicative Timeline (please note these dates remain subject to change) 

  • Initial conversation with a hiring manager: w/c 21 September 
  • Interviews: late September – early October 
  • We expect to make an offer to the successful candidate by mid October if not before.

title: Technology Transformation - Senior
description:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".


Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.


  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Apprentissage statistique et IA générative - CDD de 12 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en apprentissage statistique et IA générative pour rejoindre le département Image Données Signal (IDS) à Télécom Paris.

Le sujet spécifique de ce post-doc porte sur la calibration des modèles génératifs pour des données. Dans la littérature, il existe très peu de résultats pratiques et théoriques concernant la capacité des modèles génératifs à fournir, au moment de l'inférence, une mesure d'incertitude sur certaines propriétés ciblées. C’est pourtant un pré-requis pour utiliser l’IA générative dans des domaines critiques tels que la santé ou la sécurité. Le post-doctorat explorera ce nouveau sujet à la lumière des outils récents de calibration en commençant pour la génération de données multivariées et étudiera à terme comment l'approche choisie peut être étendue à des données non euclidiennes telles que les graphes.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de l’Apprentissage statistique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en apprentissage statistique et maîtrisez l’apprentissage statistique, les modèles génératifs ainsi que les méthodes de quantification de l’incertitude. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Des connaissances en espaces de Hilbert à noyau autoreproduisant et en transport optimal seront appréciées. Vous disposez également d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques et d’une bonne capacité de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 14 octobre 2026

Type d'emploi : CDD de 12 mois
Description de poste ici
Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June  - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.

  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

title: Financial Controller (H/F)
description:
À propos d'ILLUIN Technology

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.

Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Financial Controller afin de structurer et d’affirmer la fonction Finance comme un véritable partenaire de la performance et le la prise de décision.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement au Chief Financial Officer, membre de l'équipe Finance. Vocation à devenir un véritable bras droit du CFO sur les sujets de pilotage économique, vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Financial Planning & Analysis

    • Participation aux clôtures mensuelles en relation avec les équipes opérationnelles et l’expert comptable ;

    • Production des reportings financiers, supports et analyses à destination des équipes opérationnelles, des dirigeants et des investisseurs du Groupe ;

    • Elaboration et coordination des budgets et forecasts de l’activité ;

    • Construction et proposition de nouveaux indicateurs de suivi et dashboards afin de fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et la prise de décision ;

    • Structuration des processus et participation aux instances de pilotage opérationnels d’Illuin dont l’activité hybride (prestation intellectuelle et produit) offre un large éventail de sujets financiers : comptabilité à l’avancement, taux d’activité, rentabilité projet & client, ROI des investissements Sales & Marketing, suivi et valorisation du Crédit Impôt Recherche…

  • Business Partner financier de l’ensemble des parties prenantes d’une entreprise

    • Être l'interlocuteur(trice) de référence des Leads et équipes opérationnelles (chef de mission, de pôle) et transverses (Sales, Marketing, HR etc) sur les sujets de rentabilité et de pilotage ;

    • Participation à l’élaboration de la stratégie et à l’amélioration continue des Opérations des équipes Sales et Delivery (pricing, contractualisation, staffing, cash collection etc)

    • Sensibiliser les équipes non-financières aux enjeux de gestion (culture de la marge, discipline de facturation, pilotage du recrutement)

  • Data & Process Owner

    • Elaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus et de l’outillage financier du Groupe dans un contexte de croissance avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Mise en place et enrichissement des livrables (dashboard, reportings, outils) pour accompagner la prise de décision. La Finance est garante de la qualité de la donnée permettant une prise de décision éclairée.

Des missions ponctuelles variées d’analyses et d’audit en fonction des demandes et décisions de la Direction et des investisseurs du Groupe (M&A, ouvertures de filiales, opérations de financement, déploiement d’outils…)

 
 

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Diplômé/e d’une Grande école ou d’un Master spécialisé en Finance des Entreprises (Contrôle de gestion, audit…),

  • Une première expérience solide en Finance au sein d’une direction financière ou en cabinet de conseil/audit,

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils d’automatisation, l’IA appliquée à la Finance et le traitement de la donnée,

  • Maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets à un niveau avancé.

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un rôle à fort impact et forte visibilité en lien direct avec la direction et l’ensemble des acteurs de la trajectoire d’Illuin

  • Un coaching et une montée en compétence rapide assurée par le CFO donnant une trajectoire d’évolution claire vers des postes à responsabilité autours du pilotage de la performance financière ;

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro.

description:

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Business Recruiter (30min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Sophie Parachey, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Sophie et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos.
